rules.cwe_name: Permissions, Privileges, and Access Controls
rules.description: Legacy access-control category for failures in permissions, privileges, or authorization enforcement.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Passing user supplied arguments to a Javascript to Python translation engine such as Js2Py can lead to remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere
rules.description: A protected resource crosses its intended trust or control boundary and becomes accessible to an unintended actor.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call with Incorrectly Specified Arguments
rules.description: Using a named argument whose name does not correspond to a parameter of the called function or method, will result in a TypeError at runtime.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Access Control
rules.description: An access-control policy is missing or incorrectly enforced for a protected resource.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Using jinja2 templates with 'autoescape=False' can cause a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrectly Specified Argument Value
rules.description: Calling super with something other than the enclosing class may cause incorrect object initialization.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
rules.description: Using user-controlled data to create a template can lead to remote code execution or cross site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection')
rules.description: Interpreting unsanitized user input as code allows a malicious user to perform arbitrary code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File
rules.description: From user-controlled data saved in CSV files, it is easy to attempt information disclosure or other malicious activities when automated by spreadsheet software

rules.cwe_name: Use of Less Trusted Source
rules.description: A remote endpoint identifier is read from an HTTP header. Attackers can modify the value of the identifier to forge the client ip.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
rules.description: Using externally controlled strings in a command line may allow a malicious user to change the meaning of the command.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
rules.description: Untrusted CR or LF characters are not neutralized before use in line-delimited protocol metadata.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
rules.description: Binding a socket to all interfaces opens it up to traffic from any IPv4 address and is therefore associated with security risks.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive System Information to an Unauthorized Control Sphere
rules.description: Leaking information about an exception, such as messages and stack traces, to an external user can expose implementation details that are useful to an attacker for developing a subsequent exploit.
